body.p: Earlier there wandered a man and a girl through the mountains, nomadizing with reindeer. The girl's father went off, his daughter stayed at the bonfire. The girl waited for her father one night long, the father is not there. She waited, until it became night; in the night the was sitting there and cried. Being [so], on the opposite side of the bonfire there stood a bear. The bear imitated everything, what she did, it imitated everything. The girl took fire, the bear took fire, too. The girl held fire to her head, the bear did likewise. The fire burnt its head; the bear galloped off blaring. So it ran off. The girl's father came to the bonfire, he had killed only one elk.
